title: Zephyr: CoAP server complete
description: Implement CoAP server in Zephyr per project-LICHEN-o6pb. Includes: RFC 7252, block transfer. Pass shared test vectors.
close_reason: CoAP server complete: RFC 7252 codec (coap_codec.c, host test passes), RFC 7959 block transfer (coap_blockwise.c), Zephyr CoAP service (coap_server.c). Shared test vectors from coap_messages.json/coap_block.json are integrated. Host tests pass, Zephyr tests require native_sim on Linux.
